hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */index.html|*/locales/*|*/src/*) root=$(git -C "$(dirname "$f")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$root" ]; then out=$(cd "$root" && npm test 2>&1 && npm run lint:i18n 2>&1); code=$?; if [ $code -ne 0 ]; then echo "$out" 1>&2; echo "POST-EDIT CHECK FAILED for $f -- npm test / npm run lint:i18n did not pass. Fix before continuing (see output above)." 1>&2; exit 2; fi; fi ;; esac; }
